name: Shojo no Shinjin Hisho ga Injo ni Ochiru Made ~Omae no Yakume wa Nikutai Settai da~
original_name: 処女の新人秘書が淫女に堕ちるまで ～お前の役目は肉体接待だ～
source:
She questioned why she was chosen for the role, given her unconventional background. I explained that the most important aspect of being a secretary is the role as a face for the company. She blushed at the direct compliment, indicating her lack of experience with such praise. She inquired about her living arrangements, which typically involved living on-site. I informed her that I would guide her to her new residence later in the evening. I instructed her to begin her training, which was more like self-study, in the secretary room. As she entered the room, unaware of what awaited her, I couldn't help but smirk. She had no idea that she would soon be sacrificing her body.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1261170]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
鉴于她非传统的背景，她质疑为什么选择她担任这个角色。我解释说，作为一名秘书，最重要的是作为公司的门面。她因为这种直接的赞美而脸红了，这表明她缺乏这种赞美的经验。她询问了她的生活安排，通常涉及住在现场。我告诉她晚上晚些时候我会带她去新住处。我指示她在秘书室开始训练，更像是自学。当她走进房间时，我不知道等待她的是什么，我忍不住傻笑。她不知道自己很快就会牺牲自己的身体。
